BinSentry files six international patent applications

The PCT applications cover a suite of technologies that extend from feed mill to barn.

Industry ReleaseOctober 1, 2026

schedule2 Min Read

BinSentry

BinSentry Inc., a global leader in artificial intelligence powered animal feed inventory management technologies, has filed six international patent applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty to secure broad patent protection for the technology that supports its feed bin level monitoring platform.

The six PCT filings on Aug. 28 advance BinSentry’s intellectual property strategy and its intention to protect its cutting-edge innovations as the company continues to develop technology solutions that are transforming the $500-billion global animal feed supply chain.

“Filing the PCT applications marks an important milestone in protecting our IP on a global scale and strengthens our position as the industry leader providing scalable innovations that deliver clear results and measurable value for our customers,” said Nathan Hoel, BinSentry co-founder and CTO.

The PCT applications cover a suite of technologies that extend from feed mill to barn, including:

Related:FTC warns farmers of fake online equipment, livestock ads

System and Method for Managing a Multi-Bin Feed System (PCT/CA2026/000034): Detects when bin slides should be swapped, or have not been swapped, to prevent outages.

Detection and Removal of Obstruction From Height Map of Material in a Bin (PCT/CA2026/000015): Removes unwanted objects from 3D readings using artificial intelligence

Method of Mapping Bulk Material in a Bin Using Modified Radial-Basis Function (PCT/CA2026/000036): Novel algorithm extrapolates topology data to fill in the blank spots of the feed surface that the sensor cannot see to enable a complete volume calculation.

Direct Time-of-Flight Sensor for Measuring Level of a Bin (PCT/CA2026/051083): A better form of time-of-flight measurement for reading bin levels.

Sensor System Having RGB Camera and Time-of-Flight Camera (PCT/CA2026/000016): Combines a colour camera with time-of-flight to get better images, data and rendering.

Self-Cleaning Sensor System for a Bin (PCT/CA2026/051069): A rotating housing that keeps the optical windows from getting dirty.

“These applications underscore BinSentry’s commitment to advancing cutting-edge science to provide major protein producers and feed millers with purpose-built tools that have the biggest impact on their bottom line,” said Ben Allen, BinSentry CEO.

“BinSentry is leading the way in developing artificial intelligence solutions for agriculture to help some of the world’s largest companies transition from outdated and inefficient manual systems to automated, real-time feed inventory management that is more profitable, more efficient, safer and more sustainable. Nobody else comes close.”

translationZh:
BinSentry公司已根据《专利合作条约》提交了六项国际专利申请，为其饲料仓库存监测平台所依托的技术争取广泛的专利保护。BinSentry Inc.是全球领先的人工智能驱动动物饲料库存管理技术企业。

这六项PCT申请于8月28日提交，推进了BinSentry的知识产权战略及其保护前沿创新的意图。该公司持续开发技术解决方案，正在变革价值5000亿美元的全球动物饲料供应链。

BinSentry联合创始人兼首席技术官Nathan Hoel表示：“提交这些PCT申请是我们在全球范围内保护知识产权的重要里程碑，也巩固了我们作为行业领导者的地位，为客户提供可规模化的创新方案，带来明确的成果和可衡量的价值。”

这些PCT申请涵盖了一套从饲料厂到畜舍的技术，包括：

**多仓饲料系统管理与方法**（PCT/CA2026/000034）：检测料仓滑板何时应更换或尚未更换，以防止断料。

**料仓物料高度图中障碍物的检测与去除**（PCT/CA2026/000015）：利用人工智能从3D读数中去除不需要的物体。

**使用改进径向基函数映射料仓散装物料的方法**（PCT/CA2026/000036）：新型算法外推拓扑数据，填补传感器无法看到的饲料表面空白区域，从而实现完整的体积计算。

**用于测量料仓料位的直接飞行时间传感器**（PCT/CA2026/051083）：一种更优的飞行时间测量方式来读取料仓料位。

**具有RGB相机和飞行时间相机的传感器系统**（PCT/CA2026/000016）：将彩色相机与飞行时间技术相结合，获得更好的图像、数据和渲染效果。

**料仓自清洁传感器系统**（PCT/CA2026/051069）：旋转外壳可防止光学窗口变脏。

BinSentry首席执行官Ben Allen表示：“这些申请彰显了BinSentry推进前沿科学的承诺，为大型蛋白质生产商和饲料厂提供专门打造的工具，对其盈利产生最大影响。”

“BinSentry在开发农业人工智能解决方案方面处于领先地位，帮助一些全球最大的企业从过时且低效的人工系统过渡到自动化、实时饲料库存管理，这种管理更盈利、更高效、更安全、更可持续。没有其他公司能与之匹敌。”
